cards.brief: Business Standard reported that India’s October goods exports rose 45% year over year to $49.47 billion, while imports rose 16% to $89.35 billion. The goods trade deficit widened to a high for the year of $39.88 billion.

evidence: India's goods exports increased 45 per cent to USD 49.47 billion in October, compared to USD 34.11 billion in the same month last year. Imports also rose 16 per cent to USD 89.35 billion from USD 76.69 billion.

evidence: trade deficit widened to a year high of USD 39.88 billion.
claims.statement: The goods trade deficit widened to a high for the year of $39.88 billion.

cards.headline: Policy support, exporter resilience drive strong Oct trade performance: CII
cards.mechanism: A larger import bill can widen the goods deficit even when exports grow faster in percentage terms.
cards.watch: Watch the next trade release for whether the gap narrows and whether export growth extends beyond October.

catalyst_review: November 17 has two distinct signals: the IMD’s severe cyclone intensification forecast and the scheduled ASEAN–India and East Asia summits in Manila. The earlier November 16 cyclone-formation forecast describes a different intensity stage. PFC’s dividend record date and Nvidia’s earnings preview supply no material India-wide next-day development. The FAA assessment began November 16 with no standalone November 17 milestone, and Delhi Metro’s adjusted Chhath service is on November 16. The coal and crop IPOs begin later, and the older November 17 UP electoral-roll preview is in publication history rather than fresh captured evidence.

catalysts.evidence:
Depression over Bay of Bengal likely to intensify into severe cyclonic storm by Nov 17, move towards Andhra Pradesh coast: IMD
The weather system is likely to become a Severe Cyclonic Storm over the westcentral Bay of Bengal by the evening of November 17, the IMD said.
catalysts.text: The IMD expects the Bay of Bengal system to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm by the evening of November 17, with the forecast track toward the Andhra Pradesh coast.

catalysts.evidence: Modi will travel to Manila on November 16 to participate in the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit the following day.
catalysts.text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to attend the ASEAN–India Summit and East Asia Summit in Manila on November 17.

hero: India’s goods trade gap widened in October even as exports grew faster than imports year over year. Coal India’s sale of a stake in Mahanadi Coalfields has a price band, and Escorts Kubota laid out plans for a tractor plant. An aviation safety audit is underway as Assam prepares to table flood-plain zoning legislation. SEBI outlined proposed safeguards for AI use, and Bharat Semi raised seed funding for programmable sensors.
